title: Lost in Translation
creator: Sofia Coppola
summary: Two Americans in Tokyo find each other at 3am. A film about the specific loneliness of being somewhere beautiful and still feeling far from yourself.
personalNote: Two people in the wrong place at the right time. Coppola understands that the most meaningful connections exist in the space between words — the shared glance across a hotel bar, the 3am corridor, the ending we're not allowed to hear. The loneliness here is specific and true. Bill Murray barely acts and that's the whole point.
